Hi Laura,

We signed up for a trial via your self-serve flow — thanks for the great onboarding UX. Our team at Skyport is evaluating Redwood for an internal POC and we'd like a short run-through of the product next week that includes our IT/security folks.

High level:
- Goal: 30–45 minute product walkthrough for AE + SE to show inference behavior, plus a 20–30 minute IT/security pre-check (network, keys, retention, audit logs).
- Attendees: Alicia Moreno (PM), Ben Thomas (Dev lead), IT Ops group (I can loop them in).
- Time zone: We're Pacific (PST). Best windows: Tue–Thu mornings PST (Nov 2–4) between 08:00–11:30.

Can you help coordinate AE/SE and get us an IT checklist so our Ops team can confirm? If mornings won't work for your SE, mornings on our side are flexible — we can do a separate IT-only kickoff if that helps.

Thanks — Alicia

Option B (split):

If IT prefers Nov 2, we can flip accordingly but I'd prefer a live 07:00 pre-check over asynchronous unless there are legal reviewers that need more time.
